name: apple-reminders
description: Read, add, update, and complete Apple Reminders from Codex on your Mac.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Apple Reminders naturally from Codex
interface.longDescription: Read what is due, turn notes into reminders, and update or complete items in exact lists. Core runs locally on macOS 14+ without Xcode or a separate Python installation, with a bundled signed runtime and exact read-backs for successful writes. Experimental features are off by default; sections, native tags, attachments, and recovery have additional compatibility and developer-tool requirements. Changes may sync through Apple accounts and shared lists; there is no plugin-owned remote backend.
defaultPrompt: Turn these meeting notes into one reminder per action item, preserving owners and deadlines, then add them to my Work list
Create one Apple Reminder per screenshot in my Applications list, preserving any dates and useful details
Brief me on everything overdue, due today, and coming up this week
